name: Itsuka Mita Mermaid
original_name: いつか見たマーメイド
source:
To enjoy freedom to the fullest, Dorf has to go on a cruise to run away from Damia, to whom he was engaged against his will. However, he is found out by her and is forced to go on the cruise together.
Dorf is thinking of the mermaid who once saved his life, but...

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030621161157/http://artifact.gr.jp/moo/mermaid/index.htm]official website[/url]]
